There’s a support agent in all of us

We’re a diversely talented group of people — but if there’s one thing you’ll never catch us tripping over, it’s our egos. We show up for ourselves, each other, and the teams we’re building for with empathy, humility, and a bold vision for the kind of future that we’re actively co-creating.

Values at the heart of our actions

World-class support is rooted in empathy, curiosity, and determination. These values define how we expect Assemblers from all walks of life to treat our customers and each other.

Assembled is my team and title

We work across team lines, keeping our egos at the door.

Act like a support agent

We meet every challenge with rigor,  empathy, and efficiency.

Be the best partner

We strive to be our customers’ most valued partner.

Get on the plane

We go the extra mile and show up where others wouldn't.

Make feedback a gift

We all have something to learn from and teach each other.

In Assemblers' own words

Want to know what it's like to work at Assembled? Here's what these Assemblers have to say about it.

Assembled is different — the concentration of smart, driven people here is unlike anywhere else, and who truly care about customer success.

Wasim Ali
Partnerships

Assemblers are relentlessly creative, optimistic, and open. I learn something new from this team every single day — and every day I get to watch my teammates grow. It's an honor.

Charlie Rotholtz
UX Design

The team’s unique culture allows us to constantly tackle complex problems at a fast pace, while always staying grounded in our empathy for our customers and each other.

Sam Dehart
Sales

Working at Assembled has its perks

We take care of every Assembler in big and small ways, because a happy, fulfilled team is critical to achieving our mission.

Competitive compensation and equity

All Assemblers are encouraged to act like owners. We’re building the best team, and our compensation packages reflect that.

Comprehensive insurance and 401(k)

Between our 401(k) plan and coverage for health, dental, vision, and more, Assemblers don’t have to worry about the future.

Employment sponsorship opportunities

We proudly sponsor employment visas for candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the United States.

Stipends for wellness and development

Assemblers get monthly stipends for things like gym memberships and continued learning and development.

Flexible work arrangements

We love to see each other in person but we also like options. Remote employees get a one-time credit to improve their home office.

Office perks

Coming into the office has its perks, like catered lunches 5× per week, hanging out with our awesome teammates (and their dogs!), and the good snacks.

Notice to candidates
We have been made aware of recruitment scams where individuals impersonate recruiters to fraudulently obtain candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and job offers. Please note that all available job openings at Assembled will be posted on our website and all Assembled recruiters will be contacting you through an email address ending in "assembledhq.com" Any outreach claiming to be from Assembled via other sources should be disregarded.
